description: Removes one participant from a signature request. Requires: signature_participant_create → participantId, signature_request_create → requestId, case_file_create → caseFileId. Use it to drop someone added by mistake, or to change a role (delete, then create again with the new role, since role is not updatable). Returns no body; confirm with signature_participant_list. To drop every invalid participant at once use signature_participant_invalid_purge instead.
name: signature_participant_delete
